test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Identify the FALSE statement.

options.text: Hydrotropism is the tendency to grow in moist areas, i.e., the movement of roots towards high humidity.
The sunflower is a phototrophic plant.
Geotropism is demonstrated by the downward migration of roots.
The growth of pollen tubes towards ovules is an example of geotropism

solution:
The correct answer is __**the growth of pollen tubes towards ovules is an example of geotropism**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hydrotropism** is the** tendency of plants to grow towards moisture**, typically seen in root movements towards areas of high humidity.
 
• The **sunflower** is known for its **phototropic behavior**, meaning it grows towards light.
 
• **Geotropism** refers to the growth of plants in **response to gravity**, such as roots growing downwards.
 
• The **growth of pollen tubes towards ovules** is actually an example of **chemotropism**, not geotropism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Phototropism** is the growth of an organism in response to a light stimulus.
 
• **Hydrotropism** and **geotropism** are important mechanisms that help plants optimize their growth conditions.
 
• Understanding these tropisms is crucial for agricultural practices and improving crop yields.
